title: BADAN methodology telemetry — learning footprint batch
description: ADR-0011 / D-37. One submission = one batch of learning footprints. This schema IS the boundary: `additionalProperties: false` at every level and closed enums are what stop 'footprint' quietly widening into 'reading'. Every omission below is deliberate and is listed in `x-deliberatelyOmitted` so a future field has to argue with a written reason rather than an absence.

schemaVersion.description: Bumped only by a decision that widens or narrows the boundary.

appVersion.description: Low cardinality. Without it a footprint cannot be attributed to the build whose constants it is about.

contractVersion.description: The algorithms.json version the footprint's constants came from — the whole point of collecting this at all.

metricId.description: A contract identifier from the shipped registry, not user data.

algorithmId.description: Which method drew the reaction. The entire analytic point.

direction.description: The SIGN of disagreement. Carries no magnitude and no reading.

eventCountBucket.description: Never a raw count. The floor is 10 because that is the calibration minimum — below it nothing is sent at all. A count of 1 would re-identify a single tap.

calibrationApplied.description: Feedback on a calibrated number means something different from feedback on a raw one. Boolean, so it carries no magnitude.

x-deliberatelyOmitted.readings: Every health value. The Never this decision narrows survives precisely because none of these leave.
x-deliberatelyOmitted.offsetMagnitude: How far a calibration moved a number is a function of that number.
x-deliberatelyOmitted.periodKeyOrDate: A period key is a date the user had a reading, which is health-adjacent. No timestamps of underlying values, at any granularity.
x-deliberatelyOmitted.countsBelow10: Anything under the calibration floor is not sent at all, bucketed or otherwise.
x-deliberatelyOmitted.installOrDeviceIdentifier: None, at all. See ADR-0011 for what this costs: aggregates cannot be deduplicated.
x-deliberatelyOmitted.localeRegionTimezone: With a small user base, region is an identifier.
x-deliberatelyOmitted.osVersion: osMajor was considered and dropped — no analytic use was identifiable, and a field with no use is pure risk.
